name: pixeltable_list_catalog
description: List tables, views, and directories in the local Pixeltable catalog.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Local catalog directory, or empty for the root.

arguments.name: include_counts
arguments.desc: Run count queries and include row counts. This can be slower on large tables.

name: pixeltable_describe
description: Return schema, computed-column, index, and version metadata for a local table or view.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Local table or view path.

name: pixeltable_rows
description: Preview up to 100 rows without evaluating unstored computed columns unless explicitly requested.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Local table or view path.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum rows to return.

arguments.name: columns
arguments.desc: Optional column subset. Explicit unstored columns may be evaluated.

name: pixeltable_get_row
description: Look up one local table row using primary-key values in declared key order. The table must declare a primary key; pixeltable_describe reports whether it does.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Local table path with a primary key.

arguments.name: primary_key
arguments.desc: Primary-key values in the order shown by describe.

arguments.name: columns
arguments.desc: Optional column subset.

name: pixeltable_errors
description: List failed computed-column values for a local table that has a primary key. The table must declare one; pixeltable_describe reports whether it does.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Local table path with a primary key.

arguments.name: column
arguments.desc: Optional computed column to filter by.

name: pixeltable_insert_rows
description: Insert 1 to 1,000 JSON rows into a local table and run its stored computed columns.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Local base-table path.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.desc: Rows keyed by declared column name.

arguments.name: on_error
arguments.desc: Abort the batch on a computation error, or retain rows and record errors.

name: pixeltable_recompute
description: Preview or run computed-column recovery. Defaults to failed rows only and a dry run.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Local table or view path.

arguments.name: columns
arguments.desc: Computed columns to recompute.

arguments.name: errors_only
arguments.desc: Only recompute rows whose selected column failed.

arguments.name: dry_run
arguments.desc: Return the plan without changing stored values.

arguments.name: cascade
arguments.desc: Also recompute dependent computed columns.

name: pixeltable_scaffold_app
description: Initialize the project and write one Pixeltable 0.7 application or brief schema example.

arguments.name: kind
arguments.desc: Generate an HTTP service application or a brief schema-only application.

arguments.name: output_path
arguments.desc: New project-relative Python file. Defaults to app.py or schema.py.

name: pixeltable_schema_check
description: Validate a TableModel schema file without reading or changing a catalog.

arguments.name: schema_file
arguments.desc: Project-contained Python schema file.

name: pixeltable_schema_diff
description: Read the migration plan between a TableModel schema file and a local or hosted target.

arguments.name: schema_file
arguments.desc: Project-contained Python schema file.

arguments.name: target
arguments.desc: Local catalog directory or pxt://org:database/path URI.

name: pixeltable_schema_update
description: Reconcile a TableModel schema against a target. Destructive plans require explicit permission.

arguments.name: schema_file
arguments.desc: Project-contained Python schema file.

arguments.name: target
arguments.desc: Local catalog directory or pxt://org:database/path URI.

arguments.name: allow_destructive
arguments.desc: Permit column or index drops. Unsupported expression/type changes remain refused.

arguments.name: dry_run
arguments.desc: Return the plan without changing the target.

name: pixeltable_schema_prune
description: Preview or remove target tables that are absent from the TableModel schema.

arguments.name: schema_file
arguments.desc: Project-contained Python schema file.

arguments.name: target
arguments.desc: Local catalog directory or pxt://org:database/path URI.

arguments.name: dry_run
arguments.desc: List removals without dropping tables.

name: pixeltable_service_check
description: Validate a FastAPIRouter application without changing a catalog or starting a service.

arguments.name: app_file
arguments.desc: Project-contained Python service application.

name: pixeltable_service_diff
description: Compare declared FastAPI services with a local or hosted target without changing either.

arguments.name: app_file
arguments.desc: Project-contained Python service application.

arguments.name: target
arguments.desc: Local catalog directory or pxt://org:database/path URI.

arguments.name: service
arguments.desc: Optional declared service name.

arguments.name: enable_otel
arguments.desc: Include OpenTelemetry state in the comparison.

name: pixeltable_service_update
description: Start or reconcile declared services against a local or hosted target.

arguments.name: app_file
arguments.desc: Project-contained Python service application.

arguments.name: target
arguments.desc: Local catalog directory or pxt://org:database/path URI.

arguments.name: service
arguments.desc: Optional declared service name.

arguments.name: allow_destructive
arguments.desc: Permit route removals or changes that stop serving existing routes.

arguments.name: dry_run
arguments.desc: Return the plan without starting or restarting services.

arguments.name: enable_otel
arguments.desc: Start services with OpenTelemetry instrumentation.

arguments.name: port
arguments.desc: Port for one named service.

name: pixeltable_service_list
description: List services known locally or for one explicit local/hosted target.

arguments.name: target
arguments.desc: Optional local catalog directory or pxt://org:database/path URI.

name: pixeltable_service_stop
description: Stop one or more named services without removing their configuration.

arguments.name: names
arguments.desc: Service names or TARGET/NAME references.

name: pixeltable_service_prune
description: Preview or remove running services absent from the application file.

arguments.name: app_file
arguments.desc: Project-contained Python service application.

arguments.name: target
arguments.desc: Local catalog directory or pxt://org:database/path URI.

arguments.name: dry_run
arguments.desc: List removals without stopping services.
